scope: Stage 3B first-frame runtime adaptations for the locked Celeste 1.4.0.0 generated source

entries.originalFailure: Celeste startup ordinarily initializes FMOD Studio and loads native banks, but Stage 3B must not link or stage FMOD.
entries.transformation: Compile the original high-level Audio implementation out only under TVOS_AUDIO_DISABLED and compile a deterministic inert implementation with compatible handle/state behavior. Route every one of the 490 generated low-level FMOD guards through a counted fail-fast boundary.
entries.behavioralRationale: First-frame execution does not require audible output, while game state expects ordinary music, ambience and SFX calls to be safe. A low-level call remains a hard failure and cannot masquerade as working audio.
entries.validation: Simulator and device preflight plus sustained Celeste runs require fmod-low-level=0 and report aggregate no-audio use.
entries.futureStage: Stage 5 replaces this source-level boundary with the licensed FMOD 1.10.09 native integration.

entries.originalFailure: System.Xml.Serialization runtime code generation is not a safe startup dependency for a trimmed full-AOT tvOS application.
entries.transformation: Route Settings only through an explicit reflection-free serializer for the locked public Settings field set. Reject unknown elements and reject SaveData serialization in Stage 3B.
entries.behavioralRationale: The explicit implementation preserves first-run defaults and the expected XML field representation without runtime serializer generation. Durable save handling remains deliberately out of scope.
entries.validation: First-run, default and non-default round trips, UserIO round trip, malformed/unknown XML, and representative legacy XML pass on trimmed simulator and full-AOT device.
entries.futureStage: Stage 6 supplies durable save/settings persistence and expands serializer coverage deliberately.

entries.originalFailure: Legacy desktop/iOS path selection does not define the isolated temporary-only Stage 3B settings contract and may address non-durable tvOS locations implicitly.
entries.transformation: Require CELESTE_TVOS_SESSION_ROOT supplied by the host and place settings/error output only beneath that ignored per-process temporary directory.
entries.behavioralRationale: This permits serializer and startup testing without claiming durable saves or selecting a final tvOS persistence model.
entries.validation: Host creates a fresh process-scoped temporary directory; settings preflight writes and reads only there.
entries.futureStage: Stage 6 replaces the ephemeral path with the durable save bridge.

entries.originalFailure: Setting GCSettings.LatencyMode to SustainedLowLatency threw PlatformNotSupportedException on the arm64 tvOS simulator.
entries.transformation: Under TVOS_STAGE3B, retain the platform default GC mode and emit one checkpoint instead of assigning the unsupported mode.
entries.behavioralRationale: The change avoids an unsupported tuning request; it does not alter game data or bypass engine initialization.
entries.validation: Trimmed simulator and full-AOT device enter the normal update/draw loop and sustain frames.
entries.futureStage: Retain unless a future supported .NET tvOS runtime exposes an equivalent tuning control.

entries.originalFailure: Managed thread-priority mutation is unsupported or non-portable in the tvOS sandbox and is only a desktop loading optimization.
entries.transformation: Suppress priority mutation only under TVOS_STAGE3B while preserving thread creation, joins, work and failure propagation.
entries.behavioralRationale: Scheduling hints are not correctness requirements; loader behavior and exception visibility remain intact.
entries.validation: Normal opening/title flow reaches Celeste.Overworld on simulator and device without loader failure.
entries.futureStage: Reassess only if a supported tvOS scheduling API is shown necessary by profiling.

entries.originalFailure: Celeste desktop helpers can launch child processes or open log files, operations unavailable in a tvOS application sandbox.
entries.transformation: Make error-log opening an explicit logged no-op and make any unexpected general process launch fail with PlatformNotSupportedException under TVOS_STAGE3B.
entries.behavioralRationale: No shell/process launch is hidden; unreachable desktop behavior cannot invoke a tvStub or escape the application.
entries.validation: Accepted startup logs contain no process-launch attempt, tvStubs call or swallowed fatal exception.
entries.futureStage: Keep as the explicit tvOS platform behavior.

entries.originalFailure: The validated SpriteFont XNB requested Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Content.ListReader<System.Char, mscorlib>, which modern FNA could not resolve because the legacy core-library identity is absent.
entries.transformation: Compile a Stage 3B-only FNA extension that maps the one exact validated legacy reader spelling to a directly constructed ListReader<char>. Do not edit the pinned FNA submodule.
entries.behavioralRationale: The generic element type is unchanged; only the obsolete assembly-qualified mscorlib spelling is normalized at the content-reader boundary.
entries.validation: The actual ContentManager loads Monocle/MonocleDefault and all six reader nodes in its graph on trimmed simulator and full-AOT device.
entries.futureStage: Retain as content compatibility for the locked 1.4.0.0 assets.

entries.originalFailure: A trimmed Release preflight initially discovered empty reflection sets because constructors, command methods and reflected type metadata were removed.
entries.transformation: Root 196 exact type metadata entries, 22 exact constructors and 75 exact command methods, plus the seven exact FNA content readers. Do not preserve the complete Celeste assembly.
entries.behavioralRationale: The roots correspond to measured attribute/reflection discovery sets and exclude blanket preservation.
entries.validation: Deterministic category counts and hashes match between Debug reference, trimmed simulator Release and full-AOT physical-device preflight.
entries.futureStage: Extend only when later gameplay evidence proves another focused reflected member is required.
